mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have a temperature of 74 degrees, which feels like 82, with overcast skies hanging over the Verona Area High School and a Waxing Gibbous moon overhead.

In city news, the student sticker contest is moving to the voting phase starting July 28. Students in grades K through 12 submitted original designs to be featured on our official election stickers. Also, keep in mind the city policy on mailbox maintenance to avoid damage during the upcoming plow season.
We have a busy couple of days ahead. Live music is happening today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, you can head over to Insight Wellness for a yoga session.
In our weekly police report, on July 13, officers responded to a situation where a driver became stuck on a large rock, resulting in an arrest for an O-W-I.

The Culver's flavor of the day is the delicious OREO Cookie Overload. The store is currently closed but will open its doors at 10 AM. If you are looking for tomorrow's treat, it will be Snickers Swirl.
